Simple fun game, good to kill time, I guess if you wanted to it would be a pretty easy game to play while jerking it with one hand, simple up, left, right down button movement some enemies you bash others you avoid and then attack. It's got achievements and two levels to choose from and 2 modes. It might not seem much but one mode is fairly easy and then the second mode where 1 hit means your dead sure isn't as easy at first. Best of all its 11mb and its free and not graphical heavy for those who are still running lighter stuff.

Things I hope/might be coming anyways - Steam Cards and more levels

For now I recommend this game, but hopefully adds more features (which I'm fairly sure the dev will).

So this game is very fast paced. Ridiculously. Fast. Paced. I know its still in beta, but I can't help to ask why the controls to pick up items aren't in the controls menu. I had to figure it out the hard way. The controls sometimes feel very fast and very sensitive, and if an enemy is near and I'm whinding up for a punch, I find that I swing too early and end up punching too fast. This could be fixed by adding full animations (or you could hold down a key to build up the attack). But, all in all, this game is great! It feels like a mini flash game, and I like it that way! It has great co-op, multiplayer, and single player. 5/5.

Very cool little casual fighting game with a fighting pig as the main character.  The feel of it reminds me of One Finger Death Punch.  Enemies run at you from the left and the right and you can use the 4 direction keys to duck, jump and execute standing, ducking or jumping attacks which can damage or disarm enemies allowing you to catch their weapons and use them briefly for melee strikes or to throw at enemies.  You probably won't get a whole lot of play time out of it, but its free and its well done and worth a few moinutes of your time.
